title.ko: 제안과 설득: let's · why don't we · how about · I think we should
title.en: making suggestions and persuading: let's, why don't we, how about, I think we should

explain.ko: 제안은 Let's + 동사원형(Let's go), How about + -ing(How about going hiking?), Why don't we + 동사원형(Why don't we have dinner?), I think we should + 동사원형 등으로 말합니다. 동의는 Good idea / I agree / That's a good suggestion, 정중한 반대는 I'm afraid I don't agree / I'm not sure about that으로 말합니다. 상대를 설득할 때는 이유(because ..., it will ...)와 장점(a benefit is ...)을 함께 말하고, 타협은 Why don't we compromise / meet in the middle?로 제안합니다.
explain.en: Make suggestions with Let's + base verb, How about + -ing (How about going hiking?), Why don't we + base verb and I think we should + base verb. Agree with Good idea / I agree / That's a good suggestion, and disagree politely with I'm afraid I don't agree / I'm not sure about that. To persuade, give reasons (because ..., it will ...) and benefits; to compromise, say Why don't we compromise / meet in the middle?

notes.ko: How about 뒤에는 -ing나 명사가 옵니다(How about a walk?).
notes.en: After How about use -ing or a noun (How about a walk?).

notes.ko: Why don't we 뒤에는 동사원형만 옵니다.
notes.en: Why don't we is followed by the base verb only.

notes.ko: 반대할 때는 이유를 덧붙이고 대안을 제안하면 설득력이 높아집니다.
notes.en: When you disagree, give a reason and an alternative to be more convincing.
